text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected paragraphs with multiple supporting points","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops ideas in a clearer overall structure with an introduction, body paragraphs, and a conclusion that stay on topic."},{"evidence":"specific transitions like \"Not only\" and \"Also\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The writing uses more linking language to connect ideas and show relationships between points."},{"evidence":"extended reasons and examples about teachers, students, and community","quality":"development","description":"The essay expands its argument with more elaboration rather than repeating the same claim."},{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and sentence types","quality":"sentence variety","description":"The essay shows more control in combining simple and complex sentences to create a less repetitive rhythm."},{"evidence":"fewer severe grammar breakdowns than repeated run-ons in B","quality":"grammatical control","description":"The writing has stronger overall control of sentence structure and agreement, even though it still contains errors."},{"evidence":"more precise academic phrasing like \"understand a subject\" and \"extra help\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses clearer and more appropriate vocabulary for an academic argument."}]}
